name: Nub Open Trabuco Hills Fall 2025
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NubOpenTrabucoHillsFall2025#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab. This competition is in partnership with Team Nub, [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://i.imgur.com/vLCf2t9.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
